tree.heading: Members
tree.text: The members of the Council shall be the following:

children.text: Such other individuals as may be designated by the President.

tree.heading: Attendance of Chairman of Joint Chiefs of Staff at meetings
tree.text: The Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff (or, in the absence of the Chairman, the Vice Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff) may, in the role of the Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff as principal military adviser to the Council and subject to the direction of the President, attend and participate in meetings of the Council.

notes.text: Amendments2006—Pub. L. 109–163 designated existing provisions as subsec. (a), inserted heading, and added subsec. (b).
